optimizedContext.value:
# Kernel

## Rules
- `Kernel` groups use cases: `changes`, `specs`, `project` — never top-level.
- `kernel.specs` MUST NOT expose `SaveSpecMetadata`/`InvalidateSpecMetadata`; `PersistSpecMetadata` not mounted (internal to `MaterializeSpecMetadata`).
- Every exported application use case (except `_shared/`) MUST have `Kernel` entry + `createKernel` wiring.
- Entries typed as concrete use-case classes; callers use `kernel.<group>.<uc>.execute(...)`.
- `createKernel(config, options?)` uses shared `CompositionResolver` path; one shared `ChangeRepository`, per-workspace `SpecRepository`, `SchemaRegistry`, lazy caching `SchemaProvider` (via `ResolveSchema`; failures not cached; never `null`), `HookRunner`, `RunStepHooks`, `ContentHasher`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`.
- No use case calls `SchemaRegistry.resolve()` directly — only `SchemaProvider.get()`.
- Hooks come from schema via `schemaOverrides`; kernel ignores `config.workflow`.
- Registry/view helpers composition-owned; kernel facade only — no second merged-registry source.
- VCS/actor via `createVcsAdapter`/`createVcsActorResolver` — no hardcoding `Git*`.
- `FsChangeRepository.get()` auto-invalidates on artifact drift when past `designing` OR active approval; cause `artifact-drift`; legacy `"artifact-change"` normalized.
- Expose `changes.repo` + `specs.repos`.
- `KernelOptions.extraNodeModulesPaths` appends schema search paths; supports repo overrides + additive registries (storage/VCS/actor/parsers/external hooks). Graph-store NOT core.
- Expose merged registries (final built-in+external); reject conflicts/unknown refs.
- Binding map: `changes.*` (create/status/countTasks/transition/approveSpec/approveSignoff/draft/restore/discard/archive/validate/compile/list/listDrafts/listDiscarded/edit/skipArtifact/updateSpecDeps/listArchived/getArchived/runStepHooks/getHookInstructions/getArtifactInstruction/detectOverlap + repo); `specs.*` ( + repos); `project.*` (listWorkspaces/getProjectContext/getConfig/getMetadata/updateMetadata).
- No `listPlugins` / skills-manifest / config-mutation on kernel — plugins via `getConfig().plugins`; writes via `createConfigWriter()`.
- `execute()` inputs MUST NOT re-pass construction-time config. Allowed overrides only: `CompileContext`, `GetProjectContext`, `GetSpecContext`, `TransitionChange`, `ArchiveChange`, `RunStepHooks`, `GetStatus`, `CreateChange`, `ValidateArtifacts` (fields per full spec).
- `createKernel` returns plain immutable object, not class.

## Constraints
- Kernel = mandatory domain use-case entry; config mutation = `createConfigWriter()`.
- Missing Kernel entry for exported domain UC = violation (except ConfigWriter ops).
- Removing Kernel entry = breaking change.
- No business logic in kernel — wiring/grouping only.
- `createKernelInternals` not exported; `Kernel` + `createKernel` public.
